units.source_text: 村落里的人，敢于如此无理地冒险，当然该有大致的预防对策吧。

en.t: If the people of the village dared to take such an unreasonable risk, they must of course have had some general precautions in place.

units.source_text: 乡下的巡逻警只有一个或两个，笼络不起来。

en.t: There were only one or two rural patrol officers, and they could not be won over.

units.source_text: 就是难得来看一次，村落里也一定会收拾得天衣无缝。

en.t: Even if they did come by once in a rare while, the village would surely have everything arranged without a flaw.

units.source_text: 可是，这样的烟幕弹能起作用，所必需的，说到底就是他那健康的身体，

en.t: But for this sort of smokescreen to work, what was needed, in the end, was his healthy body,

units.source_text: 只要耐得住“清沙”的劳动即可。

en.t: so long as it could endure the labor of clearing sand.

units.source_text: 在床上躺了一星期的重病人，似乎已没有冒险去隐藏的价值了。

en.t: A gravely ill man who had lain in bed for a week no longer seemed worth the risk of hiding.

units.source_text: 如果肯定起不了作用，在未形成麻烦之前迅速地抽出手来，不失为聪明的举动。

en.t: If it was certain he would be of no use, quickly withdrawing before trouble developed would be a wise move.
For now, it could still be explained away.

units.source_text: 如果硬说男人不当心掉了进去，因受惊而导致陷入非分的妄想，

en.t: If they insisted that the man had carelessly fallen in and, from the shock, had slipped into improper delusions,

units.source_text: 比起中计而被幽闭等等非现实的控诉，这种显然更合情理的说明，一定更容易被接受。

en.t: then this clearly more reasonable explanation would surely be easier to accept than his unreal accusations of having been trapped and confined.
